The '''Assimilated Jack o'Lantern''' is the infested form of a regular Jack o'Lantern.

== ''Obtainment'' ==
A regular Jack o'Lantern cannot be infested or turned into an Assimilated one by [[Beckon]] infestation or conversion via the [[Parasite Biome]]. It can only be obtained by crafting with an [[Assimilated Pumpkin]] and a Torch.
{{CraftingTable|r1_a1=Assimilated Pumpkin|r1_b1=Torch|r1_output=Assimilated Jack o'Lantern|r1_count=1}}

== ''Usage'' ==
Like a regular Jack o'Lantern, it emits a low light. This is its only use as of now.
